name: com.absurdlyobvious/games
title: Absurdly Obvious
description: Daily logic puzzles (Thunk, Nuzzle, Wrackle) you play right in the chat.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: The Absurdly Obvious daily puzzle games: id, name, rules, scoring and the progress format each game uses with the other tools.

tools.name: play_game
tools.description: Open a daily puzzle: today's board for a game, or an older one by number. Shows an interactive board the user plays in the chat, plus a text version of the board and the rules.

game.description: Which game, by id from list_games (for example "thunk").

date.description: The user's local date (YYYY-MM-DD), so "today" matches their day. Optional.

number.description: Board number (No. 1 was the game's first day). Leave out for today's board.

tools.name: game_move
tools.description: Replays the player's progress on a board and returns where things stand: the board as text, the score so far, what the last move did (including mistakes and why), and whether the game is finished. Used for text play and by the board widget.

game.description: Which game, by id from list_games (for example "thunk").

number.description: Board number (No. 1 was the game's first day).

progress.description: Everything the player has done on this board from the start, in the game's own format (list_games describes each). Empty for nothing yet.

tools.name: game_hint
tools.description: One hint for the player's current position on a board: the single next step, never the whole answer. Each hint counts on the player's score.

game.description: Which game, by id from list_games (for example "thunk").

number.description: Board number (No. 1 was the game's first day).

progress.description: Everything the player has done on this board from the start, in the game's own format (list_games describes each). Empty for nothing yet.

tools.name: game_result
tools.description: Checks a finished game and returns the verified score, share text with emoji, and a challenge link a friend can open to play the same board. Records an anonymous play count for the site's stats; nothing about the user.

game.description: Which game, by id from list_games (for example "thunk").

number.description: Board number (No. 1 was the game's first day).

progress.description: Everything the player has done on this board from the start, in the game's own format (list_games describes each). Empty for nothing yet.

hints.description: How many hints the player took.

seconds.description: Time spent in seconds, if known.
